title: Cyrene QQ client extension contract
description: Fixed QQ operation requests and responses. The operation is selected by the direct method name; service/method passthrough is forbidden.

qq_parameter.$comment: Shared field definitions for operation-specific request schemas.

qq_result_object.$comment: Normalized Host result envelope. Exact native overloads remain owned by the authorized Host; the worker rejects unsafe values before this seam.

qq_response_envelope.$comment: Successful direct operation response after worker normalization.
